Situation Report

  • STRIKES: IDF completed a wide-scale wave of strikes in the heart of Tehran minutes ago. Target: Iranian regime infrastructure. (Deep-capital strike = escalation in target set.)
  • Air campaign: US–Israel strikes continue across Iran (Day 27).
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah firing daily. Cross-border missile/rocket exchanges continue; local escalation persistent.
  • Diplomacy / Pauses: US President announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET — citing an Iranian request; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. (First 5‑day pause was violated.)
  • Hormuz / Shipping: Trump granted extension tied to Strait reopening. Iran has allowed passage for selected friendly states (Russia, India, China); selective access increases political leverage.
  • International tech transfer: Reuters reports China’s top chipmaker supplied chipmaking technology to Iran’s military. Tactical implication: could accelerate Iran’s weapons/air‑defense production and complicate sanctions enforcement.
  • Airspace & logistics: Flight-scan shows 578 aircraft airborne, 3 military (RCH845, RCH797). Airports closed in Iran and Iraq. Commercial movement and evacuation options constrained.
  • Domestic Iran: Tehran bars national teams/clubs from travel to ‘unfriendly’ countries — increased isolation and security posture.
  • 🟢 Good News: US granted a 10‑day pause/extension that reduces immediate risk to international shipping for now.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

דיווח מצב

  • תקיפות: צה"ל ביצע גל תקיפות רחב בלב טהראן לפני זמן קצר. מטרה: תשתיות משטר איראני. (פגיעה עמוקה בלב הבירה = העלאת רף היעדים.)
  • קמפיין אווירי: תקיפות ארה"ב–ישראל נמשכות נגד אתרי איראן (יום 27).
  • גבול צפוני: חיזבאללה פועל יומי; חילופי אש רקטיים/טילים חוצים־גבול נמשכים.
  • דיפלומטיה/הפוגות: הנשיא האמריקאי הכריז על הפסקה שנייה במתקפות על אנרגיה — 10 ימים עד 6.4.2026 בשעה 20:00 ET — לפי בקשת איראן לטענתו; טהראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן מתווך. (ההפוגה הראשונה הופרה מהירה.)
  • מפרץ הורמוז/שילוח: הארכה קשורה לפתיחת המיצר. איראן מאפשרת מעבר למדינות ידידותיות (רוסיה, הודו, סין) — מה שנותן לה אמצעי לחץ פוליטי.
  • העברת טכנולוגיה בינלאומית: רויטרס מדווחת שחברת השבבים הגדולה של סין סיפקה טכנולוגיית ייצור שבבים לצבא איראן. השפעה טקטית: תאוצה בייצור נשק והגנה אווירית, וסיבוך לאכיפת סנקציות.
  • מרחב אווירי ולוגיסטיקה: סריקת טיסות מציגה 578 כלי טיס באוויר, 3 צבאיים (RCH845, RCH797). נמלי תעופה באיראן ובעיראק סגורים. תנועה אזרחית והסעות מצומצמות.
  • פנים איראניים: איסור יציאת נבחרות ולאומיות למדינות "עוינות" — הידוק מצב ביטחוני ובידוד.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: ארה"ב העניקה הארכה של 10 ימים שנמנעת כרגע מהחרפה מיידית בתנועת הסחורות הימיות.
  • הערכת איום: מתדרדר.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • STRIKES: IDF completed a wide-scale wave of strikes in central Tehran (01:18). Iranian and proxy missile/rocket attacks on Israel continued overnight. Projectile from Lebanon killed at least one civilian in the north. Hezbollah ATGM strike in southern Lebanon killed 1 Israeli soldier and wounded 4.
  • Northern Border: Daily Hezbollah activity. Cross-border rockets, anti-tank strikes and sniper/ambush threats persist. Expect continued frontline casualties and periodic escalation.
  • Air campaign & pause: U.S. announced a second 10-day pause on strikes against Iran's energy sector (deadline Apr 6, 20:00 ET), citing an Iranian request; Tehran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. Reminder: the prior 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Diplomacy: U.S. reportedly sent Iran a written plan to end the war. Iran lodged a protest at the UN over U.S. use of Gulf states' territory.
  • Strategic tech & logistics: Reuters: China’s top chipmaker supplied chipmaking technology to Iran's military — may accelerate weapons and missile production. Iran allows passage through the Strait of Hormuz for select 'friendly' states (Russia, India, China) while blocking others. Flight scans report airports closed in Iran, Iraq and Lebanon.
  • Casualties & impact: Confirmed civilian fatality in the north. Confirmed military fatalities/wounded on Lebanon front. No verified reports of Israeli domestic infrastructure collapse from this cycle.
  • 🟢 Good News: U.S. pause extended; Pakistan mediating; U.S. plan reportedly on the table — provides a short window for de-escalation.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

Northern Border

Diplomacy & Negotiations

  • US reportedly sent Iran a written plan to end the war. Pakistan says indirect talks are occurring.
  • Iran lodged protests at the UN over Gulf states allowing US operations from their territory.

Intelligence, Tech & Cyber

  • Cyber scan: at least one CRITICAL incident reported in last hours.
  • US deployed uncrewed drone boats to the theater (reported).

International moves

  • Airspace/airports: multiple regional airports remain closed (Iran, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon reported in scans).
  • EU/others increasing pressure on Russia over support to Iran; no major troop deployments reported.

Casualties & Impact

  • Military: Israeli soldier killed, 4 wounded. Ongoing missile exchanges; civilian casualty(s) in north Israel.
  • Infrastructure strikes reported in Tehran and other Iranian cities.

🟢 Good News

  • 10-day pause on energy strikes could open room for a negotiated pause. US reportedly delivered a plan and Pakistan is mediating indirect talks.

Threat assessment

  • Escalating.

Situation Brief — Day 27

  • Active: IDF completed wide-scale strikes in central Tehran; explosions were reported. Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile and rocket strikes continued against Israel overnight.

Northern Border

  • Hezbollah attacks are daily. Projectile from Lebanon killed at least one civilian in northern Israel.
  • Israeli soldier killed and four wounded in southern Lebanon by an anti-tank missile.

Maritime / Hormuz

  • President Trump extended a 10-day pause on strikes targeting Iran's energy sector (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET). Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating indirect contacts.
  • Iran allows Strait of Hormuz passage for select states (Russia, China, India). Others still blocked.

Air & Strike Campaign

  • US/Israeli airstrikes continue inside Iran (recently reported in Tehran; earlier strikes hit Isfahan and Khorramshahr during prior pause).
  • US deployed uncrewed drone boats to the theater, expanding maritime strike/surveillance options.
  • Airspace disruption: multiple airports in Iran, Iraq, Lebanon and Syria reported closed.

Capabilities & Intelligence

  • Reuters: China's top chipmaker supplied chipmaking technology to Iran's military. Tactical impact: potential boost to Iran's indigenous missile/air-defeat production over time.
  • Cyber: one critical cyber incident reported in the last 48 hours.

Diplomacy & Politics

  • US reportedly sent a written plan to Iran. Pakistan says indirect talks are ongoing; Tehran denies bilateral negotiations.
  • Iran filed protests to the UN over Gulf states permitting US use of their territory for strikes.
  • Domestic: Israeli military requests more weeks for the campaign; political tension between Bennett and Netanyahu persists.
  • 🟢 Good News: The 10-day pause on energy strikes and reported indirect contacts create a limited diplomatic window.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
